lines.trans: All these people around are ungrateful scumbags.
Chef, one should not think so badly about everyone.
I taught them to cook the city's best dishes.
Every cook remembers your great lesson.
Then why are they following someone else's orders now?
They are simply afraid of losing their job.
A true master is never afraid of difficulties.
You are the main culinary master for us.
Let them handle the complex banquet themselves now.
Without your participation, chaos will break out in the kitchen.
That is great, let them see my strength!
I will stay by your side anyway.
